caption: Oakwood Laboratories LLC v. Thanoo
citation_line: Oakwood Laboratories LLC v. Thanoo, No. 3:17-cv-05090, ECF No. 83 (D.N.J. Oct. 23, 2019), vacated, 999 F.3d 892 (3d Cir. 2021)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Sheridan dismissed four successive complaints alleging theft of pharmaceutical-development trade secrets, breach of contract and tortious interference.
qualification_rationale: The precedential appeal became a leading Third Circuit authority on pleading claims under the Defend Trade Secrets Act, including identification of trade secrets and plausible allegations of acquisition, disclosure or use.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit vacated and remanded, concluding that the detailed third amended complaint readily satisfied federal pleading requirements and clarifying DTSA pleading standards.
decision_selection_note: The docket marks this entry VACATED, matching the Third Circuit vacatur at 999 F.3d 892.
